description: Revert to the proven aggressive learning rate configuration (Matrix LR 0.11, Embedding LR 1.4) with Depth 10 and Batch 128, as the current best result (0.9800) was achieved with a conservative LR (0.08) that likely under-utilized the 5-minute budget by converging too slowly, while historical data consistently shows the aggressive setup achieves better convergence (~0.983 bpb) within the time limit.
